description: Defines models and fields for HR contract management, including employee details, marital status, wage types, and contracts in an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: hr_employee_marital_status
classes.description: Model for storing employee marital status options.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Model extending employee details with additional fields like manager status, medical exam date, and marital status.

classes.name: hr_contract_wage_type_period
classes.description: Model for defining wage period types with name and hours in period.

classes.name: hr_contract_wage_type
classes.description: Model for defining wage types (hourly, daily, monthly) with associated period and factors.

classes.name: hr_contract
classes.description: Model for employee contracts including start/end dates, wage info, and related fields.

methods.name: _defaults
methods.description: Default values for model fields, such as current date and standard working hours.
